name: TradingLab Best MACD Strategy
summary: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers combined with trend filtering, entering long positions when MACD crosses above its signal line in an uptrend and short positions when it crosses below in a downtrend. It uses standard MACD indicator values to generate systematic entry and exit signals without discretionary intervention. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts confirmed by MACD histogram direction changes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD信号线交叉结合趋势过滤进行交易，在上升趋势中MACD上穿信号线时做多，下降趋势中MACD下穿信号线时做空。它使用标准MACD指标值生成系统性的入场和出场信号，无需主观干预。该策略旨在捕捉由MACD柱状图方向变化确认的动量转换。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用MACD指标的经典信号线交叉来捕捉市场动量的方向性变化。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生交叉，同时结合趋势方向过滤以避免逆势交易——多头信号需在价格处于上升趋势时确认，空头信号需在下降趋势中确认。出场条件通常依赖反向MACD交叉信号或预设的止盈止损水平来平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面依赖于止损设置来控制单笔风险，但没有明确的每笔最大风险百分比控制或权益回撤保护机制。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对市场波动性、交易时段和点差等环境因素的适应性调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to capture directional shifts in market momentum using the classic MACD signal line crossover. Entry conditions require the MACD main line to cross above the signal line for longs (or below for shorts), combined with a trend direction filter to avoid counter-trend trades — long signals must be confirmed in an uptrend and short signals in a downtrend. Exit conditions typically rely on a reverse MACD crossover signal or preset take-profit and stop-loss levels to close positions. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an account balance-proportional approach, but lacks a dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management relies on stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk, but there is no explicit maximum risk percentage per trade or equity drawdown protection mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively basic, lacking adaptive adjustments for market volatility, trading sessions, and spread environment factors.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: MACD是成熟经典的动量指标，信号逻辑清晰易懂，便于验证和优化
结合趋势过滤能有效减少逆势交易的假信号，提高胜率
策略参数化程度高，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活调整周期和手数
系统化执行消除了人为情绪干扰，保证了交易纪律的一致性
pros_en: MACD is a well-established classic momentum indicator with clear signal logic that is easy to verify and optimize
Trend filtering effectively reduces counter-trend false signals and improves win rate
High degree of parameterization allows users to flexibly adjust periods and lot sizes for different instruments and market conditions
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference and ensures consistent trading discipline
cons: MACD信号存在明显滞后性，在快速反转行情中入场较晚导致利润空间缩小
缺乏对市场波动率（ATR）的自适应机制，在低波动横盘市中容易产生频繁假信号
默认止损止盈为零，若用户未手动设置则交易将无保护地暴露在无限风险中
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
未考虑交易时段和点差过滤，在流动性差或点差扩大时可能产生不利成交
cons_en: MACD signals have noticeable lag, leading to late entries during rapid reversals which reduce profit potential
Lacks adaptive volatility mechanism (ATR), prone to frequent false signals in low-volatility ranging markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, exposing trades to unlimited risk if users do not manually set them
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar leading to overtrading
Does not consider trading session or spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills during low liquidity or widened spreads
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率动态调整止损距离，提高策略对不同市场环境的适应性
添加新K线检查和最大持仓数量限制，防止重复开仓和过度交易，同时加入点差过滤避免高成本成交
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive stop-loss and take-profit mechanism that dynamically adjusts stop distances based on market volatility, improving strategy adaptability across different market conditions
Add new bar check and maximum position count limits to prevent duplicate entries and overtrading, along with spread filtering to avoid high-cost executions

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，若用户忘记设置则交易无任何价格保护，可能遭受大幅亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在单根K线上多次触发信号导致重复开仓
没有最大回撤保护或账户权益监控，在极端行情下可能持续加仓扩大损失
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero — if users forget to set them, trades have no price protection and may suffer significant losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially triggering multiple entries on a single bar leading to duplicate positions
No maximum drawdown protection or account equity monitoring, which may lead to continued position addition and expanded losses during extreme market conditions

It uses standard MACD indicator values to generate systematic entry and exit signals without discretionary intervention. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts confirmed by MACD histogram direction changes.
